markers.name: Altar of the Deeps
markers.to: Unverified: return toward the Blackfathom Deeps entrance; see uncertain

uncertain: Dashed stepping stones in I show the documented jump route through the Drowned Sacellum; exact gaps and ledge shapes require verification.
The dashed underwater outline in III is a schematic basin connecting the Fathom Core and the northern Old Serra'kis alcove; precise submerged walls and supports are not verified.
T marks the altar behind Aku'mai. Sources disagree about its return-teleport function versus a buff-only function. Vanilla 1.12 behavior and the destination must be verified in game.
notes: Only the instanced dungeon is shown.
This full-clear numbering visits the underwater encounters before Kelris. They can also be visited later.
Baron Aquanis is summoned through the Horde Fathom Core quest interaction, not a mandatory encounter. Q5 is the quest-starting drop from boss 5.
Q2 also serves the objective of In Search of Thaelrid.
Lady Sarevess and Thaelrid are reached by swimming beneath rock overhangs.
The four small squares beside Kelris represent the braziers that trigger the event opening the final door.
Twilight Falls and The Orb of Soran'ruk use distributed creature drops in the Moonshrine area; no fixed pickup is asserted.
No Season of Discovery teleport network is included. Panels are schematic and not to scale.
